<description>
This sets `permissions: contents: read` on the CI workflow, which is all the jobs use.

On this repository the token is already read-only, through the repository's default. The workflow's `permissions` key then adjusts that default ([GitHub docs](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#how-permissions-are-calculated-for-a-workflow-job)), so the setting now lives in the workflow.

The same change for libsecp256k1 is bitcoin-core/secp256k1#1964.

Closes #36512.
</description>
